assessment.verdict: ₹35 LPA total CTC is your final goal. Treat it as a stretch target until a matching employer confirms the budget and role level. Use ₹20 LPA+ discovery to build a pipeline while testing higher budgets.
reasoning: Your documented TCS offer is ₹17.00L total CTC, including ₹13.63L fixed basic plus benefits. Your ₹35L goal is approximately 106% above that offer.
Published role ranges and self-reported salaries are different evidence. A range ceiling does not establish the package you would receive.
Target roles that value your Pega delivery, Kafka integration and production ownership. Confirm the approved budget and experience expectations before investing in multiple interview rounds.
Keep recurring fixed pay, variable payout, equity and one-time joining bonuses separate when comparing any offer.
negotiation_notes: Frame the ask around senior Pega delivery and integration ownership: CSSA, Kafka/REST, auto-finance collections and verified production outcomes. Use only experience that the candidate can substantiate.
State 24–27 LPA as the desired total package and 22–24 LPA as the preferred fixed component; keep these as separate negotiation objectives.
Ask recruiters to confirm the role's approved band and experience flexibility before investing in a process requiring five or more years.

Request an itemized annual breakup separating recurring fixed cash, target variable, employer contributions/benefits, equity and one-time joining or retention amounts. Compare like components with the actual TCS offer.
Use the real 17 LPA offer accurately when negotiating; do not represent online salary ranges as another offer or imply guaranteed bonuses.
Treat 27 LPA and the fixed-pay preference as outcomes requiring a sufficiently funded role and strong interview evidence, not as an automatic percentage hike from current salary.

methodology: Research checked on September 7, 2026 for the supplied Bengaluru/India profile: four years at MBRDI, CSSA senior developer/SSA/integration focus, current CTC 11.574 LPA, TCS offer 17 LPA with 13.626 LPA fixed. Candidate figures were provided in the task; the original offer was not re-audited by this research subtask.

Prioritized posted salary budgets with matching responsibilities, then transparent crowdsourced sources exposing role, city, experience or sample size. No broad software-engineer company band was relabeled as a Pega band.
All amounts are annual Indian rupees; one lakh equals 100,000 rupees. Ranges preserve the source's stated meaning in summary, including percentile intervals and modelled ranges.

Basis fixed is used only for a page explicitly labeled base pay; it is not proof of an employer's contractual fixed-CTC definition. Unitemized advertisement pay remains reported_salary or unknown; explicitly stated CTC is total_compensation.
Source dates retain only dates exposed by the source. Month-only dates retain YYYY-MM precision; crawl/check dates are not substituted for publication dates.
Sample size is attached to the actual cohort represented. Single submissions are n=1; missing counts remain null. Mirrored vacancies are counted once.
No averaging across these records was performed: jobs, old incumbent disclosures, percentile distributions and mixed experience cohorts are not statistically comparable.

Excluded training-provider promotional pay tables, anonymous forum guesses, overseas salaries, rates converted from contract work, unrelated platform-vendor SDE/SDET salaries and unsupported company-specific bands from the old local intelligence files.
limitations: Eleven evidence records include three quantified posted vacancies, seven crowdsourced observations/cohorts, and one official vacancy with undisclosed pay. They are a research sample, not a representative salary survey.
No verified 2026 offer to an exactly four-year Bengaluru CSSA/MBRDI-comparable candidate was found, and no exact role/company/location/experience cohort establishes 22–24 LPA fixed.
Several salary disclosures date to 2024–2025 or do not expose source dates; online retrieval in 2026 does not make the underlying compensation current.
Advertised ranges may cover different levels and do not confirm budget availability, employer flexibility, payroll arrangement or a live opening.
Crowdsourced figures can be sparse, modelled, rounded, incorrectly classified or biased toward particular employers and levels. Provider verification claims were not independently audited.
Some evidence was accessible only through indexed full-page text because direct page retrieval failed or was restricted; those records identify that limitation.
Salary metadata cannot establish team quality, direct GCC employment, benefits value, job security or whether leaving the present employer is the right decision.
